{{Youmay|the docking bay on a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world|the [[Docking Bay 73 (Tatooine)|docking bay]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] or the [[Docking Bay 73|docking bay]] on [[Trendivar]]|linebreak=1}}
'''Docking bay 73''' was located at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. An team of new [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] recruits were to rendezvous with a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] in docking bay 73 and receive a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] full of supplies. The transfer was interrupted by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], but the Alliance recruits managed to escape with the supplies.<ref name="NRRG">{{WEGCite|story=New Recruits and Rebel Guns|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>
